reviews.author: Cari Breckenridge
reviews.text: Amazing atmosphere! Awesome variety of stuff in their gift shop! Was able to not only eat at the yacht club but also attend their Christmas Day potluck! So amazing what all they do for the community! Really good food and great staff! Great location!

We want to give a special shout out to “Stephanie” in the Main Event Room. reviews.author: R Farmland
reviews.text: There is so much going on here. Two different bands in two separate bar areas. They start early and it goes on into the night. Sometimes they have famous singer/songwriters performing. We come here every year while on vacation.

address: 101 E Beach Blvd, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Deidre Knapp
reviews.text: What a cool place!  It uses unique items as part of their decor!  The way burger, fries & Gouda grits & sweet tea  were excellent.  My server, Shay was friendly, professional and attentive.  She recommended a signature sauce to use for my fries.  Delish!  I sat on their deck and was able to enjoy a little more of the beach from a different perspective!

reviews.author: Kimeisha C.
reviews.text:

reviews.text: First time going to the Hangout to have dinner yesterday evening and it was phenomenal! Ricky made our experience absolutely fantastic! Extremely tentative and kept us laughing the whole time just making sure we had everything we needed as well a great time! 100/10 rating! Will certainly go back every year we come to Orange Beach. reviews.author: ViviAnn Lane
reviews.text: My new favorite place!!! The ambiance is really nice, the food is really good and the service was the Best! You get it all in this one place!! Our waitress, Monica was so nice and checked on us several times. The food arrived hot and pretty quick! Even all the pass arounds were served hot and tasty! I actually caught my roll!! I will definately be sharing my experience to all!!

reviews.author: Rafe Bar
reviews.text: Really enjoyed everything we got, I recommend the ribeye, the fried chicken was good as well. Seems like a random item but is probably my favorite side is the pickled cucumbers and onions, very good! Cornbread was good as well, and can’t forget the throwed rolls! The rolls pair well with apple butter and sorghum. The only difference between here and the sikeston location is no gift shop.

reviews.author: Randall Deaton
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Rafael Mora
reviews.text: Enjoyed my food. First time coming. They do throw those delicious bread rolls. The atmosphere is not as comfortable in my experience. This is a straight 4.5 in my book. Delicious southern food with a twist of fun. I would like to come back and try other plates. I would recommend the visit. The only thing is the understood, uncomfortable stare, from the locals and some staff. If there is a friendlier more welcoming to other ethnicities local I would give the absolute 5 stars.

reviews.text:

There's a small beach and an extra bar area with live music.

Thanks from our group to yours for being so gracious and inviting to us!!  Rick

reviews.author: Christina
reviews.text: My hubbington and I had an amazing experience, and the light show was fantastic! Everyone was friendly and nice. The stores were reasonably priced, and the Ferris wheel is a must!

reviews.author: David Murray

It is definitely on our list to return as a favorite!

Had to ask waitress few times for items already asked for (extra ginger, yum yum sauce)… host was little slow getting back to post ,
Overall good experience and would come back.

Greeted well at the door, prompt to be seated.

Ambiance and decor remained with the theme.

Our server forgot and missed a few things but not too terrible.

Our cook/chef had fun right along with us.

Food was perfectly seasoned.
The serving was so much, I had to split it but definitely not complaining, lol.

If I were in the area again, I'd visit this establishment again.

reviews.author: Tj Mathias
reviews.text: Catch of the day sandwich was great! Some tasty fries and great sweet tea. The beignets are really good. The service was friendly and the atmosphere was fantastic. Fun gift shop too!

reviews.author: MarStar
reviews.text: Awesome, awesome place. John was our servicer today. He was polite and kind and patient when I couldn't decide what to eat. He was very knowledgeable of the menu. reviews.author: Cindy Wakefield
reviews.text: One of our favorite breakfast spots in orange beach. We’ve been coming here for years. The view is incredible and the food and drinks are a great match. I’ve had multiple menu items and the pancakes are my favorite - fluffy and light. Our server Abbey was great. Overall, it’s always a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: jerry browning
reviews.text: Great view of the bay, nice setting, great atmosphere. Attentive staff. Variety of entree selections, all that we ate were exceptionally very tasty. We tried Breakfast once, and Lunch another time: both times were good food, and very enjoyable.

reviews.author: Tina Linder

Spectacular views, especially at sunset sitting outside!

Definitely worth a stop here & enjoying a good meal.

You will have a great experience, guaranteed!

reviews.author: Stephanie Thompson

Our entrees were delicious as well- the Royal red shrimp dinner and the special which was Royal red shrimp in  a Cajun brown butter sauce. Our server Shaylah was awesome. A must try. Great food and atmosphere.

reviews.author: Christine Lipscomb

We got started with bar drinks and 2 appetizers. My entree was a platter featuring fried oysters, grilled grouper, scallops, hush puppies, baked potato and vegetable of the day (green beans). The homemade tartar sauce is very good. My husband had the fresh fish and 2 sides.

reviews.author: Cassandra Evans
reviews.text: We had the gumbo, coconut, shrimp, and the red fish special with grilled shrimp and mushroom gravy on top. The onion rings were good. Everything we had was delicious . We had excellent service from our server Ryan.

Our waitress was very friendly and suggested some appetizers from the happy hour menu despite it being almost an hour past happy hour.

The best part of our experience was Hope - she was very kind and patient, and even helped me pick my entree. The portions are VERY generous, so you may want to skip the appetizers.

Firecracker Shrimp - very salty, but the sauce had a great flavor; just not very spicy.

Surf n Turf - I got it with the Blackened Shrimp. The star of the meal was honestly the grits at the bottom of the plate. The steak was seasoned well, but was pretty tough cooked at a Medium-Rare. The Shrimp was good as well, not

name: Sam's Deli
address: 27122 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Russell Benefield Jr
reviews.text: Food was poorly prepared. Never had an issue with the breakfast but lunch was awful. BBQ sandwich was drowned in bbq sauce and the sandwich I had was soaked in horseradish mayo. Onion were definitely not sautéed and the meat was cold. So ended up feeding the meat to my dog.

reviews.author: Rachel Graham
reviews.text: Best store in Orange Beach.  There is nothing that you need that they don't have. Best muffins I have ever had. Clothing, groceries fishing supplies and gas too.

reviews.author: J.T. Baxter
reviews.text: Hopefully the owner has serious hormonal issues. I have never encountered such a beast!!  If I were starving I wouldn’t order from here ever again. As a customer of over 5 years the level of rudeness increases daily. It’s just a sandwich...Dayum I wish there was a negative star rating. 👎 ⭐️  I’m really going to miss that sandwich!!!

reviews.author: Kerri Vintson
reviews.text: Sam's Gas is $1.99 the cheapest in Orange Beach, they have a Great Fishing department, clothing and a deli..

reviews.author: Edward
reviews.text: Great place, Little bit pricey but they have almost anything that you need.

name: Another Broken Egg Cafe
address: 25910 Canal Rd Suite K, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Dynathia Dunn
reviews.text: Avery was AWESOME!!! Sweet professional and fun!! The whole staff was super nice and welcoming! The food was amazing and plentiful. Will definitely be coming back just from the smiles and attitudes of them! 🩷

reviews.author: EJ W
reviews.text: We ate breakfast here on Veterans Day. They had festive french toast and all the fixins. We were welcomed and seated quickly. They explained everything and gave us fresh beignets! It was a nice experience and their food was very good. We will be returning to try other bites. Thanks for a nice Veterans breakfast! Yumm!

reviews.author: Falon Outlaw
reviews.text: DELICIOUS! My husband and I both got the Lobster & Brie omelet. It was our first time at this restaurant and they brought us free beignets and they were amazing. Our waitress was Jessica and she was very knowledgeable and friendly! Highly recommend if you make it down to Orange Beach, AL :)

reviews.author: Karen Doyle Homan
reviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed the crunchy French toast with eggs and bacon. OMG, so good! Done perfectly. Our friend had pancakes with eggs and sausage. He ate every bite (happily).  Amanda was our server. She kept our coffee filled, and we never felt rushed. We just had a lovely breakfast and visit with our friend.

reviews.author: Catherine Turek
reviews.text: The menu looked fantastic.  I got the special French toast with Hawaiian bread, bourbon sauce, pineapples and whipped cream. This also came with 2 eggs and your choice of bacon or sausage.  I opted for the sausage which was way overcooked and so were the scrambled eggs, cooked to a little brown, which is not what I asked for or expected. These were not tasty at all but the French toast was delicious. I also got the spiked vanilla iced coffee which was great. Hubs got the soft shell crab scramble

name: BuzzCatz Coffee & Sweets
address: 25689 Canal Rd Suite A, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Lexi G
reviews.text: Everything about this place is a cat lovers dream!! The vibes from the soft music to the friendly service to the cat puns located around the coffee shop are paw-sitively wonderful!! I got the hot chocolate and poptarts and they were both fresh and tasty.

reviews.author: EJ W
reviews.text: We enjoyed it at BuzzCatz. There were a few people, but things moved along fine. Lots of seating inside, out back, and on the patio. The omelets with ham and bacon were real good as well as the chai tea latte. The service people were fun and very friendly. Lots of other good things on the menu to check out. Put this place on your list.

reviews.author: Brady Middleton
reviews.text: We stopped by for a quick coffee and breakfast on our way out of town.  The nutella poptart and veggie quiche were phenomenal.  The King Cake latte was a little too sweet for our taste, but we're willing to go back.  The atmosphere was very relaxed and casual.  Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Ricky Payne
reviews.text: I could swim in the biscuits and gravy forever and die happy.  Pecan praline cinnamon roll was amazing as well.  Very friendly staff and awesome atmosphere.  Will definitely frequent when in the area.

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.text: The blueberry glazed biscuit was divine. My husband loved the cinnamon roll breakfast sandwich. The biscuit breakfast sandwich was probably the best I've ever had. Great coffee, super friendly and quick despite being very busy.

name: Latitude 30
address: 27200 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Kay
reviews.text: Such a great restaurant inside of this wonderful resort! We ate here several times on our stay during the summer. The service was fast, the staff were friendly and the food was always fresh and so delicious with filling portion sizes! My husband tried his 1st ever chicken n waffles here!

reviews.author: Marshae Black
reviews.text: Located inside Perdido Beach Resort. We had a really good time dining here. Very kid friendly menu. We ordered appetizers (Spin Dip and Steak Fries), kids Shrimp Alfredo, shrimp and grits, fish tacos (served with sweet potato tots) and a bacon burger. All of the food was tasty. The service was a little slow, but she was very friendly. Prices weren’t too bad either. Even with bar drinks a party of 4 ate for $150.

reviews.author: Jeremiah DuPree
reviews.text:
Okay, food. It's not bad, it's not fantastic either. It's better than any fast food, guaranteed, and it's slightly above par for a sit-down restaurant.

I would say the breakfast is better than the lunch or dinner entrees.

The staff is fantastic, friendly and accommodating. The environment/atmosphere is pleasant also. It is a part of Perdido Beach Resort.

You can dine in if you are not staying at the resort as a patron. However, there is no overnight parking available for non patrons of the re

reviews.author: Dan Reamer
reviews.text: We were pleasantly surprised with this restaurant.  The menu was a bit small but had many good options.  For a resort restaurant, the prices were really reasonable, and the food was really good.  The staple though is Miss Glinda’s omelet bar.  Only available on the weekends from what I understand but well worth the stop!

reviews.author: Amanda Riendeau
reviews.text:
Spacious restaurant inside Perdido Beach Resort. Food was fresh, Grouper tacos were excellent! Quick, friendly service. Since I'm staying here for a few days I will most likely be back there before I leave.
Ask for Melvin. Personable, kind & helpful waiter! He made the experience for sure!

name: Starbucks Coffee Company
address: 25773 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: G Hruby
reviews.text: I order the same drink at Starbucks around the USA and this particular location suffers with consistency compared to the rest.  The drink is the brown sugar shaken oat milk espresso.  The reason I ditched Dunkin for Starbucks was because of the lack of consistency they provide from store to store.  This particular location made a drink that was quite literally 85-90% ice.  I asked the second time through (on a different day, same week) if they could do something different, explaining that it was

reviews.author: M Godlewski
reviews.text: If you don’t have time to kill don’t come to this store in the morning!!  We arrived at 10:40 AM. It was a 2 minute wait to turn for parking in the lot because the drive thru is so backed up but I see why because the walk in wait they tell you at the register is 30 (thirty) minutes.    We waited around 16 minutes for our 2 drinks. Apparently there is a need for another Starbucks nearby!!!!  The employees were nice and all working hard but they have to much business at this store with  mobile, dr

reviews.author: Katrina Shoemaker
reviews.text: Ordered an iced mocha latte and it was the worst coffee I had in my life. Wasn’t even cold just seemed like they threw ice on top with no shaking and it didn’t even seem like the coffee was mixed together to be evenly distributed. As well the coffee cup broke while driving leaving a big mess in my car. 6$+ for a bad medium sized coffee then gonna ask if I wanna tip? Please go to local coffee shops not this flavorless overpriced company.

reviews.author: Crystal Harris
reviews.text: I stopped here while on a short trip in the area. I am not a Starbucks regular, but I needed to work on a laptop for a couple of hours and this was the perfect place for that! I ordered lunch and couple drinks that I thought sounded tasty. The staff were all great! The food was fresh and delicious, as were the drinks. Everyone's orders seemed to be completed impressively quick! While I was there, I heard them greet every customer with a warm welcome and even addressed several customers by name.

reviews.author: Tammy Odom
reviews.text: We work in Orange Beach and sometimes need to order breakfast to go. It’s never easy when it’s summertime at the beach, but to be July 4th as well. Ya might as well grab a book and hunker down. Today was a super busy line around the building kinda day. Cars were leaving the take out line and people seemed pretty tense. Totally a “please pack your patience” kinda mood. We were greeted by a barista with a great attitude and kind voice, even though she had already been handed a few unkind vibes. Sh

name: Dairy Queen Grill & Chill
address: 25741 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Barry Hart
reviews.text: We visit this location every Jan (snow birds).  Have always been impressed with the service.  Until last night.  Pulled in around 6:30 pm and ordered ice cream to go.  Asked for lids and a sack.  When ice cream arrived, there were no lids or a sack.  I reminded the young lady at the window that we needed lids and a sack.  She was not happy and shoved the change from my purchase with enough force, that the change flew out of her hand on to the ground.  I told her I was not worried about the chang

reviews.author: Tabitha McLaughlin
reviews.text: We stay at the Hampton Inn across the street when we are on vacation.  The food is always good and the staff is very friendly.  The ice cream is always amazing. I live about an hour away from the nearest Dairy Queen in Oklahoma so it is always a treat.  We frequentl this restaurant numerous times while we are on vacation.  Definitely will return and would recommend.

reviews.author: Susanna Pylant
reviews.text:
Ordered a couple of large Oreo blizzards at the drive thru for my husband and I with Heath Bar and Butterfinger added in. As we were pulling away, I took the spoon and stirred the blizzard around and saw there was barely anything at all mixed into it, and it was mostly just ice cream. Since we paid $21 for this, I parked the car, brought the blizzards back in and politely asked them to redo them, which they did.
That's when I opened Google reviews on this place and noticed the very low star rati

reviews.text: The burger was rather average, but I was very pleasantly surprised by the amazing cheese curds and onion rings. I’d go back for those. The service was rather lacking and I’m not sure if there was an issue with the microphone, or what, but the lady couldn’t hear us; even with turning off our vehicle which was rather quite to begin with. reviews.author: Kevin Webb
reviews.text:
Lazy and ignorant staff.
The lady with all the makeup on took my order.  Asked us to pull around to wait.   Took two more people's orders.  She finished cooking all three orders before bring out the food to all 3 customers.  Made us wait additional time for our order, because she was too lazy to get some steps in..    Terrible customer service and ignorance about anyone else in this world but herself.

name: Papa John's Pizza
address: 24515 Commercial Ave, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Jason Brown
reviews.text: Read all the other reviews and then ordered anyway. I live in Orange Beach not Gulf Shores so that helps. My pizza arrived early and was delicious. I got the Shaq-a-roni for $13.99 deal!

reviews.author: joel donald
reviews.text: Well I guess finding an employee with basic social skills is difficult in this business. Well at least the pizza was decent. Probably will not go back though.

reviews.author: Blake Kennedy

I wanted the pizza but credited on my delivery and tip b

name: Ruby Slipper
address: 24151 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Marlena
reviews.text: Local here. Food is mediocre at best. Bacon and gravy were pretty good. Chicken was tasty. Biscuits were dry and hard on the bottom. Beignets were hard, burnt, and extremely dry. Espresso machine was down, so no good hot drink with our food. Waitress was inattentive. Overall we were extremely disappointed.

reviews.author: Amanda Major
reviews.text: The Ruby Slipper Cafe on Perdido Beach Blvd in Orange Beach, Alabama, is open from breakfast through lunch. The chain originated in New Orleans, and they say they add some New Orleans flair to all their dishes. Some of their most popular orders include Blackstone and Cochon Eggs, BBQ Shrimp & Grits, and Bananas Foster French Toast. For those wanting something more potent to go with your meal, they have  Bloody Marys or Mimosas. The decor is cute, with space for dining inside and out, and the bat

reviews.author: Scott Andrews
reviews.text:
Exceptional breakfast location right in Gulf Shores, Alabama.
Our server was fast, friendly and cheerful.
The omelette was perfectly prepared and filled, and the cat’s  had biscuit was a perfect addition to the plate. I ate every bit of it!
The atmosphere is loud enough if you bring your children, but not enough if you wanna have a quiet cup of coffee for breakfast
Recommended

reviews.author: Charlene Ray
reviews.text: Crystal was a wonderful server and very nice and knowledgeable of the menu. She gave us some great suggestions of menu favorites. It was a great dining experience and I would highly recommend The Ruby Slipper!!!

reviews.author: William Wright
reviews.text: Came here today to surprise my Dad with a little treat. Was immediately greeted by Nate the bartender. Had my pup with me so we chose to sit in the patio lounge area. Crystal, was very friendly and recommended we get the Eggs Cochon Chicken St Charles. AMAZING!! Been here a couple times this WEEK. Service is always A-1. Please try the biscuits n gravy if you’re in town. Also, full bar service and a HUGE dinning area. Guess I’ll be back tomorrow😎

name: Flora-Bama Ole River Grill
address: 17400 Perdido Key Dr, Pensacola, FL 32507, USA

reviews.author: Jerry Dunne Sr
reviews.text:
Great food, I had the Philly cheese steak with onions, peppers and mushrooms and it was delicious 👍 better than anticipated.  Onion rings are also spot on!
Indoor atmosphere is good, signed wall similar to the bar across the street but much newer.  Great outdoor dining option with great views ( we sat inside.)
Our service was excellent 👌.

reviews.author: Angel Matthews
reviews.text: Customer service is phenomenal here. Everyone is so kind, made sure we was good the whole time. Food was amazing. Most definitely would recommend this place to everyone. Hailey is great at doing her job she deserves a raise.

reviews.author: Stephanie Palmer
reviews.text: We enjoy a delicious dinner - the grouper & shrimp basket, fries and hush puppies. Our adorable waitress, Hailey,  recommended an app- the key lime shrimp-yummy!!! Great service, fun atmosphere & tasty food! Quick food delivery, too!

reviews.author: Harold Willson
reviews.text: Warmly greeted when we walked in. Had a group of 7. 5 kids and 2 adults. They brought colorful slushies for the kids and they were super happy to have them. The food is amazing and the service was on par and top notch. Cameron was our server and did an excellent job. We also got the Key Lime-colada and highly recommend.

reviews.author: John Sims
reviews.text:
Our server Carlos did an excellent job! The shrimp and grits is the best thing on the menu and worth the price!

But the reason I gave this a four-star was the price and flavor ratio. The price was a little high for the quality and portion size of the food.
I got crab claws for the market price of $30 and they were just the claw with a portion of the the meat still attached to the vein, not the thick portion of the claw itself.

name: The Flora-Bama Yacht Club
address: 17350 Perdido Key Dr, Pensacola, FL 32507, USA

reviews.author: Deep South
reviews.text: Google shows temporarily closed, but I was here on Jan. 2nd, 2026 and they were certainly open. Busy bar, they could use another bartender even in the not so off season. I was surprised by how good the food was! Got the oyster sampler, which wasn't listed on the main menu??? My wife had the flatbread and it was good too. Ice cold beer and well prepared food. What more could you ask for?

reviews.author: AB R
reviews.text: Stopped in for lunch, shout out to the best & our favorite server there, HANNAH Mc. Fried crab claws still delicious and nutritious and the tuna dip was fantastic with the new chips. C power forever. #Cpowa #IYKYK

reviews.author: Kellis Williams
reviews.text:
Easy 20/5 stars. This place is the real deal!
We heard nothing but rave reviews all the way from Southern Illinois — and now we know why. Flora-Bama Yacht Club absolutely crushed it. Killer food, lightning-fast service, and one of the most laid-back, family-friendly vibes on the coast. Kids comfortable. Adults relaxed. Zero stress.

reviews.author: Jennifer Olson
reviews.text: The food was excellent, everything we ate was so good. Bradley and Patrise gave excellent service with a wonderful personality. We will definitely go back!

reviews.author: Randi Kittrell
reviews.text: John and Duy are the best bartenders ever! They’re very attentive and give the friendliest service. Give them all your tip money!

name: Island Time Daiquiris & Pizza at The Wharf
address: 4830 Wharf Pkwy W G101, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Scot Surla
reviews.text: Normally have good service, will update if I return in the future. Drove from Fairhope, saw posted online 11am food available. Walked in at 12, saw 2 people at the bar eating and asked for the menu. Was told by bartender kitchen isn't open.

reviews.author: Tia Beauleau
reviews.text: April is the best bartender! It is our first time here and she made our entire night! The drinks were delicious too! For sure will be back!

reviews.author: Sara Beth Wade
reviews.text:
The bartender will ask you if you want to pay an extra $4 for an extra shot in your drink. What they mean is would you like some alcohol in your drink? Because there isn't hardly any in the mix I was given. It was the orange/cream one and it didn't taste good at all. I ended up throwing half of it out. Maybe the alcohol was in the bottom half...

Also, the band on the patio was a kiss/aerosmith-like arena rock band, which totally didn't fit in the the sunshiney outdoor patio setting.

reviews.author: Joshua Barnett
reviews.text: They got me one time with the OBA orange daiquiri that shit is dangerous...tried them all they are all well mixed and good flavor we stop in every time we come and will definitely be back

reviews.author: Brandon Williams
reviews.text:
Small little beer and daiquiri bar. They have a nice selection of drinks between daiquris and beers. What I liked about the place was it had quick service (I did not have to wait to be served), the bar tender was very polite and helpful. You have many different sized drink options and you can add an extra shot for $4. Prices were reasonable (a lot ofnplaces are much more expensive).
I bought a 16 oz. Hurricane daiquiri, that tastes pretty damned good. After tip I spent $10. Overall satisfied wit

reviews.author: Autumn Bough (7autumn5)
reviews.text: We had breakfast and coffee. Surprisingly Southern Grind has the best bacon I’ve ever had in my life. We also had lovely outdoor seating which accommodated us with our little dog. While we were there the police chief came by to say hello and pet our dog! The coffee was amazing and we bought some whole bean coffee to take home. It was an excellent experience. You can’t get more southern hospitality than this place.

reviews.author: Alyssa Campbell
reviews.text: This is a cute little coffee shop located within The Wharf. It was one of the only shops open on Saturday morning. They have a nice selection of coffee beverages and breakfast/dessert items.

reviews.author: Reni
reviews.text: Went to this coffee shop awhile back on a girls trip in Orange Beach. The restaurant is connected to Hotel Indigo, but there is parking right outside of the coffee shop as well. If you are in the area and in search of a good breakfast/brunch spot…look no further.  Breakfast menu has a wide selection and there’s enough there to choose from to satisfy the pickiest of eaters. We ate here almost every day for breakfast and each time, we were highly satisfied with the service and quality of food. The

reviews.author: Brady Middleton
reviews.text: We had breakfast here multiple times on a recent trip to OB.  The biscuits and gravy are a hit as well as the french toast!  The coffee is phenomenal and the atmosphere is the ultimate beach theme.  We didn't purchase any gifts or items in the store, but they offer a wide range of unique, beach themed items to choose from.  100% will be back.

reviews.author: Justin Barnes
reviews.text: This is our first time checking out this place and what they were about. The staff was incredibly friendly and super helpful. I had the avocado toast with bacon and hot honey, it was delicious!!! My wife had the omelette with spinach and mushrooms. Incredibly good. The ambiance and environment Beverly chill and five with great outdoor seating. The coffee was stout and tasty. I'm a big fan and will be coming back for sure

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Lucy Curry
reviews.text: Everything about Villagio was phenomenal! The service was great, food was delicious, and ambience was lively. Highly recommend the bolognese and charcuterie, but you could not go wrong with anything on the menu! Don’t forget to stop by any of their other sister restaurants—Ginny Lane Bar & Grill, Yo-ho Tacos, or Mile Marker 158 Dockside, you wouldn’t regret it!

reviews.author: Shelby Hammer
reviews.text:

address: 26619 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Russell Ingram
reviews.text: Two of my boys and two of their friends all 4 went fishing with capt Will on board Kittywake. They fished inshore and had a blast. Caught limit of Sheepshead  and other fish. Captain Will took care of the boys and made sure they had a blast.

reviews.author: Shane Parris
reviews.text: We had a great father-son fishing trip on Killin Time! Just us two with captain Colby. He put us on some nice redfish. He was very knowledgeable of the area and very friendly and interactive. He kept our lines baited and got the fish off quickly and got us back out in the water to catch more! He also took care of cleaning the fish for us. We had a great experience and definitely will do it again!!

reviews.author: Austin Axley
reviews.text: Very awesome experience. Offshore fishing is  way different then from the fishing we do back home. The captain and deck hand were great to talk to and very knowledgeable. We did a 8 hour trip time goes pretty quick. We had a shared expense with 8 other people. Would definitely do it again. The only thing is we would do a 4 hour trip just because it wears you out being in the sun and reeling in fish but it was probably the funnest fishing I’ve done. Other then a lot of cranking you don’t have to

reviews.author: Richard Beckham
reviews.text: We booked 2 boats, Annie Girl and Sea Hunter, and both crews were exceptional. We limited out on vermillion snapper. The weather wasn’t perfect but both crews made it a memorable trip for our crew. We will definitely book another trip through Zeke’s.

reviews.author: Matthew Tanaka
reviews.text: Captain Alex and his crew are top notch. We had an excellent 44 hour trip. We caught a 175 lb yft and lost 3 equal size or bigger. I highly recommend taking a charter on the Sea Hunter!

address: 22843 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Lemonade Milkshake
reviews.text: Quite the pleasant experience in this little gem of a beach haüs coffee haüs! ☕️ Lovingly ornamented w/ all kinds of seaside decor. 🌊⚓️🧭🐙🚢☀️Enjoyed the crème brûlée frappe & a futbol ⚽️ match on the big screen. Thanks for a much returnable experience!

reviews.author: Gianna Oliveri
reviews.text:
I really
Enjoyed this place a lot! They stop breakfast at 11am and start lunch at 11am. They had a lot of drink options for everyone caffeine and caffeine free drinks and big breakfast menu with alot of options as well as healthier options. They had tons of indoor and some outdoor seating and some shopping to do inside.

reviews.author: Lotsa Luck
reviews.text: Southern Grind is such a gem in Gulf Shores! The shop itself is super cute with a warm and welcoming vibe. The staff were incredibly friendly and personable, which made the experience even better. I ordered a latte and it was a 10/10—so good that I finished it before I even made it home! This place definitely deserves a spot on your coffee stop list if you’re in the area. Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: Katrina Ricker
reviews.text: Avocado toasts were really good with crispy thick pieces of bacon! The two coffees we got were also super good. Both were sweet coffees and a little strong on the syrup, but you were still able to taste the coffee. So good!

reviews.author: J H
reviews.text: I’ve been here a couple of times years ago and absolutely enjoyed it; however, this trip was a completely different experience and I was sadly disappointed.  No hot lattes (was a cold day), waited at counter without even a “hello” (as employees carried on their personal conversation), and zero enthusiasm taking our order. address: 22843 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Emily Precious
reviews.text:
We stayed here for our honeymoon, and it was absolutely perfect. The staff is incredibly sweet and welcoming. There’s a newer lady working there who mentioned she’s only been there for three days, and she truly has the kindest soul. She made us feel so special.

When I say our honeymoon was perfect, I genuinely mean it. We are so happy we found this place.

The hotel has an indoor pool, and the outdoor hot tub is amazing for relaxation. I recommend going about an hour before the pool closes if y

reviews.author: Christina
reviews.text: My Hubbington, Potato, and I had the most amazing time at the Indigo Hotel. First off, you walk in, and it smells like Hawaiian tropics 🩷. The hotel is pristine and clean, and everyone was helpful and friendly. They have amenities for your pets. There's a wonderful coffee shop right next door that you can get to through the hotel. You don't even have to go outside. The bar was great. The themed drinks were on point and delicious. We had an amazing time and would definitely stay there again!!

reviews.author: Von Redmon
reviews.text:
Special thank you to Lesley for the warm welcome and Platinum Rewards greeting upon arrival and thank you for the upgrade!

We were in town for the Veterans Ribbon Cutting Ceremony in Fairhope, and this Orange Beach Hotel Indigo property made our stay even better. It’s a beautiful location nestled near beach homes, great restaurants, and coffee shops  especially Southern Grind Coffee House. Their baked goods are delicious! (If you’re watching your carbs and sugar, just wait until your trip is ov

reviews.author: Scott Purcell
reviews.text: Only booked because it was pet friendly and we were pleasantly surprised.  Super friendly staff - shout out to Julie who we met when we checked in and Mike who helped us with dinner.  All the rest of the staff was great as well!  Very clean, spacious rooms and an amazing view of the gulf from our room!  Unfortunately we were unable to use the pools and gym but we did get coffee at the attached coffeehouse and gift shop.  Definitely recommend!!!

reviews.author: Blaine Prickett
reviews.text:
Best hotel beach stay in Orange Beach. The staff is great. The service is great. The food is great. The bartender is my favorite. (Short hair / glasses) So fun. She remembers our family each time. She deserves all the kudos for her effort and service. The coffee shop connected to the hotel compliments the hotel very well.

If the bartender sees this, I’m still willing to pull a shift for you to get some shut eye. ;)

reviews.author: A. B.
reviews.text:
We found this awesome BBQ by smell. Sounds weird, but we could smell it long before we knew what it was and the smell sold us instantly.

We made the 1/2 mile trek down Perdido Beach Blvd and found it, the holy grail hidden amongst unsuspecting chain restaurants. From the stickers on the door to the awesome signs out front - we knew we were in for something good.

The nachos: amazing

The pulled pork: the most tender, fall apart pulled pork we have ever had. Anywhere (from Kansas City and beyond

reviews.author: BETH Dawson
reviews.text:
My family and I loved Moe's! I love the laid-back atmosphere. There's seating available inside and outside. There's lots of cool art and pictures on the wall that I enjoyed looking at. The staff was friendly and helpful when ordering.
I had the loaded baked potato with smoked chicken, and it was delicious and very filling.
I tried the Ribs my husband ordered (I forgot to get a pic), but they were tender and flavorful.
The children enjoyed chicken tenders, grilled cheese, fried Catfish, mac & che

reviews.author: William McIntyre
reviews.text: Normally I shy away from a chain BBQ place. But, the past reviews were correct. The pork had a nice smokey flavor. The service was outstanding. The chocolate Orea pudding was a nice side. It looked like many locals were they, which is a good sign. The atmosphere was very creative.

reviews.author: DL
reviews.text: Great food and a fun atmosphere to dine in. Unfortunately, they often run out of certain menu choices almost every time we are there. We keep going back though.

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.text: Had a very good lunch here. The wife got the pulled pork sandwich which was very good and I got the sausage sandwich and fries. It was really tasty. They use Conecuh Sausage which if you haven’t had it you need to get some!! The outside has a nice atmosphere.

name: Gulf to Go
address: 287 Royal Dr, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Jerry Thompson
reviews.text: Have had good success with this service most of the time. But last night our order was almost an hour late and had no condiments that we asked for with some of our food. I can understand that things sometimes get left out, but at least call and tell me that it’s going to be late. Eventually they did call but it was 30 minutes past the supposed delivery time. Come on guys, need to do better than that!

reviews.author: Lisa Price
reviews.text: Order was over 30 minutes late being delivered and only thing driver said was yeah we have been busy. The total was more than my ticket said. They add fees onto delivery onto tip for driver. My $10 meal ended up being $20. Food was ice cold and they didn't include sauce that was requested.  Won't order from here again.

reviews.author: Annette Fleisher
reviews.text: Food was warm and was delivered about 45 minutes sooner than their time line!  I wish the site had more pictures of the food dishes because I ordered way too much food from the Mexican restaurant.  Please tip your delivery people...they just make money from tips and delivery fees.  Since I hurt my ankle, I'm glad I was able to get something besides Chinese or pizza!

reviews.author: Sarah Jean

I use this service all the time, foods hot and always on time.

reviews.author: Harleigh Hughes
reviews.text: The delivery guy showed up 30 mins earlier than what was estimated and he was very nice. Food was still hot and fresh. Definitely would recommend and will be using again.

name: Tuscany Pizza and Grill
address: Pelican Place, 3800 Gulf Shores Pkwy, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Bev Horn
reviews.text: LOVE this plsce. You think you’ve walked into Italy with the atmosphere and food.  We’ve had anll different meals and Tiffany is without a doubt the best server.  She is so helpful in understanding the menu and suggestions.  Friendly to all. Love their pizza. Fixed just like I like it!!!

reviews.author: Mia Ristau
reviews.text: The alcoholic drinks were made perfectly two of them had me right where I needed to be by one of the waitresses there with long black hair. She was also our waitress and was wonderful, tended to us at the perfect times. The food was delicious and for the price was def worth it seems like it wouldn't be enough food but it filled us up and tasted wonderful. Its like fancy resteraunt but at a affordable price. We went in the late evening and sat outside and it was wonderful. I would eat here again

reviews.author: Elizabeth Schisler
reviews.text: The food is fantastic. You can tell when something is made from scratch with quality ingredients. Our server Lana was also very professional and friendly. We really enjoyed our meal and will definitely return!

reviews.author: JG
reviews.text: Sunday night dinner.  Went here for dinner.  Got seated instantly, waitress took my drink order right after.  I ordered the SPAGHETTI ALLA PESCATORA with Alfredo sauce.  Order probably took about 15 to 20 minutes. This dish was outstanding and I would highly recommend it. Great service, atmosphere and food.

reviews.author: Amy Cunningham
reviews.text: Awesome service!  Everyone loved their food.  We had 19 or so people descend upon them on a Monday night and everything was perfect’

name: Bleus Burger Restaurant and Bar
address: 3800 Gulf Shores Pkwy #240, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Tyler Smith
reviews.text: Late lunch, went for a burger, ordered the shrimp n grits, glad I did. Wow! Plump, blackened shrimp, 6 pieces, grit cakes were delicious, piping hot, the sausage & cream sauce were wonderful. Like I said, I keep showing up for a burger but they do a lot of things really well—guess I’m coming back. Good, friendly service, had an ice cold beer and thought about my next visit. I do love R&B so I could’ve stuck around. That's a nice touch. 🎶

reviews.author: James Barnes
reviews.text:
Cool atmosphere.
We were wanting a good burger after several seafood meals and this place didnt disappoint.

The burgers were delish. Our wing app was good, we got 2 flavors, and I also got the tater tots app along with my meal. Never had tots that good!

Highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: alyxandra OB
reviews.text:
The best fried pickles we have ever had! Absolutely beautiful and equally delicious burgers- and i’m not typically a burger fan!
We came on a Sunday at around 11 and the restaurant was mostly empty. Food came out quickly and was super fresh, all staff were super helpful and friendly especially our waiter!
We will absolutely be back :)

reviews.author: Jennifer Gleason
reviews.text: After having all the seafood places we could handle, our Midwest bellies were craving a good burger mixed with some BBQ. The burnt end fries were amazing, the wings, the burgers were amazing! Wish we would have found this place sooner than our last 2 days here. Our waiter Austin, was absolutely the best server we have had down here this trip!

reviews.author: Sonya Wellman
reviews.text: If you've never been, you have to try this place. The burgers are amazing and the fries are seasoned and they taste so good. name: Big Beach Brewing
address: 300 E 24th Ave, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Snow Gypsies Travelers
reviews.text: We had Fun here!! we sat by the Fireplace listen to some Great music 🎵 Buy Billy Bones!! awesome Beer 🍻 and Wine 🍷 great time great place great location.

reviews.author: William Atkins
reviews.text: Great brewery with wonderful bartenders! The beers were excellent! I didn't try the sours so I can't speak to those but all the others were good or great! Plus boiled peanuts! I'd never had them before so this was a new and very welcome experience. I had to post a picture of the taps because they are individually crafted glass. I would have posted a photo of the wonderful bartenders but I didn't ask their permission to post their images.

reviews.author: Carla Morrin
reviews.text: The beers were great, however the blond woman serving us at the bar was super rude both times we went to the counter She wouldn't answer questions and acted like we were inconveniencing her. The food was good too. Very disappointing! There is no reason to treat us like that when we got beers, food, and merchandise.

reviews.author: Michael Cornelison
reviews.text: As a person that has visited many breweries, Big Beach Brewing hit all marks. Fun atmosphere, quick and friendly staff and great beer. They have a wide selection of easy drinking beers to fun and creative beers with full flavor. I left with a six pack to take home. I would highly recommend if you are in the Gulf Shores area to stop in and check out some of their artisanal craft beers.

reviews.author: Paul Fenrich
reviews.text: This is a must stop if you are into craft beers. We tried four different beers, and they were all delicious.  The bartender was very nice, and he had a lot of knowledge of their products. The atmosphere was great. We sat outside on the upper deck and then moved downstairs. The weather was perfect, and the boys found a new friend to play cars with. Very kid friendly, several families were hanging out.

name: Groovy Goat
address: 106 S Owa Blvd A, Foley, AL 36535, USA

reviews.author: Karen Sepko
reviews.text: Came to Groovy Goat for an event!  Event room is through the Arcade to the left.  I never knew it was there!  Great space for 70 people 7 tables of 10 people.  Food was buffet style included sprimp/chicken/mixed vegetables/ fettuccine Alfredo/ mixed salad and… the best ever chocolate chip cookies!!

reviews.author: Colleen Daugherty
reviews.text: Lots of beers on tap and a large arcade for kiddos. Great for large parties both family and adult. Lots of TVs and “the game” you want to see is always on. reviews.text:
Damn. Thanks for the suggestion, Wade. The Redfish Sandwich struck a nerve. I grew up on Redfish in Florida. My mom would put potatoes in the oven and challenge me to catch dinner. Then I caught Red Snapper. We ate when the potatoes were done.
Thank you.

reviews.author: Nicole Brown
reviews.text: Food was very over priced for the quality and amount received. We ordered a cob salad (which didn’t even come out with the corn) and the chicken tender plate. The chicken tenders were $17. They were very small and chewy (over cooked) and the fries were bright yellow and appeared to be old and stale. I usually don’t write or leave a bad review but I don’t recommend this restaurant. Service was fantastic, but food did not reflect this.

address: 20733 Miflin Rd, Foley, AL 36535, USA

reviews.author: Zoe Gehman
reviews.text: Very cute inside. Live music on Saturday night was great! I had the side platter with fried green tomatoes, hash brown casserole and cabbage casserole. All very good but the cabbage casserole was so amazing I’ll need to figure out how to make at home!

reviews.author: Amanda Major
reviews.text: *Moe’s Original BBQ, “A Southern Soul Food Revival,” is located near OWA on Mifflin Road in Foley, Alabama, several red lights off of HWY 59. It’s a chain restaurant, which really means absolutely nothing, because their food consistently tastes uniquely fantastic. I’ve never had a bad meal here, and the staff is always top notch. 🌟Moe’s has been serving Alabama-Style BBQ since 1988. For people like me who don’t cook, that means they slow-smoke their meat in a pit using oak and fruit hardwoods. T

reviews.author: Shawn Shepherd
reviews.text:
If you're looking for some good bbq and sides, this is the right place. And while the food was really good....the staff were amazing! Super friendly and knowledgeable about the menu, made recommendations (which were spot on) and genuinely appeared to like what they were doing.

We arrived closer to closing time but we're never rushed and even got to hear some singing as the staff were doing a final cleaning for the night.

We'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Julia Tassin
reviews.text: First time eating at Moe’s and it was such a great experience! It’s dog friendly and everyone was so kind and sweet. I got the chicken nachos and it was delicious! The nice man even came outside to say hello and offer some turkey to my dog, overall just a great environment!

reviews.author: Kat F
reviews.text: Excellent barbecue place. Order your food at the front and it's delivered to your table. Food was very tasty and alot of it. Friendly staff.

name: Crab Trap Perdido Key
address: 16495 Perdido Key Dr, Pensacola, FL 32507, USA

reviews.author: Gary Leemgraven
reviews.text: Good menu, prices are a bit on the higher side. Server was very pleasant and attentive. Great location right off the beach.

reviews.author: Craig Kuehl
reviews.text: Very nice first visit here. Food was all excellent.  Service was outstanding by our server Cassie. We had the Alaskan King Crab Legs x 2 orders which were awesome. Wife ordered the Bairdi Crab which was recommended and it was actually better than the King Crab, both were amazing though. Would highly recommend trying this location despite the negative reviews we read. Everything was great!!

reviews.author: Drew Crouse
reviews.text: Great hot crab dip is incredible with the fried pita bread. Crabcake were exceptional.  And the Cajun chicken pasta is still my favorite

reviews.author: Cheryl

address: 23500 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Lyrehc Storm
reviews.text: Need a nice quiet getaway..Get away from the busy, crowded hotels. The original Romar House B & B is the place to be.  Bring your significant other for a nice quiet getaway, or in need of a solo getaway with peace and quiet. The host is awesome! Very friendly and an amazing cook.  We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Cecil Bolton
reviews.text:
Experience Orange Beach as it was pre-Hurricane Frederick (1979). In other words, pre- high rise condos when there were only wood stilt beach homes and a couple small hotels. Some restaurants had their own fishing pier. The good old days. Very peaceful & relaxing. We only left the Original Romar House to eat dinner..
Lilia is an awesome host & cook. Thank you for making our anniversary so special. We'll be back!
Cecil & Cynthia Bolton

reviews.author: Laura Saddlemire
reviews.text:
Lilia is truly a dream hostess! We've never stayed anywhere so welcoming, cheerful, and accommodating. From the moment we arrived, everything was seamless—check-in and check-out were a breeze, and every detail was thoughtfully handled.

Lilia is also an exceptional cook! Her French toast casserole, apple crisp, and biscuits with gravy were absolutely out of this world—every bite was better than the last.

The perks made our stay even more memorable: complimentary wine and delicious snacks at 4 P

reviews.text:
I brought my Ashley to this historic B&B for her birthday. We originally booked two nights. We loved it so much that we had to ask for an additional night. Ms. Lilia was kind to accommodate us and the perfect hostess. Every morning she cooked the most delicious breakfast that you could smell from your room. The property and house itself were charming. The private walkway to the beach, pool, and hot tub made the experience that much better.

We stayed in two different rooms during our vacation. T

reviews.author: Donna Burgess
reviews.text: Lilia is an awesome host.  She is very friendly and an excellent cook. We have visited 4 times and each time we have been treated like family.

reviews.author: Samantha Neal
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful time at this place on our first visit! The atmosphere was lively and fun, with live music that added an extra touch to the experience. The food was absolutely delicious, and every bite left us wanting more. Our favorite part, though, was the service—our bartender Kelly was amazing, making sure we felt welcome and taken care of. We will definitely be back for more great food, drinks, and good vibes! Highly recommend this spot!

reviews.author: Linsey Osborn
reviews.text: Fun pool for kids with the waterfall. Nice to have an indoor option, too, with weather here. The unit family stayed in was well decorated and clean! Food and drinks are a little pricey.
