reviews.author: Tate Ellison
reviews.text: Pretty fun little place.  Musicians start singing around noon. Karaoke on Wednesday evenings 6-10.  Don’t try and invite yourself to the electronic poker game they have every Wednesday afternoon.  It’s organized by the permanent residents at the resort.  We are only here once or twice a year a week at a time.  But it’s cute they have their little thing.   So far, all the food has been great.  Nothing I haven’t liked.   Servers are friendly as well.

name: Tacky Jacks Gulf Shores
address: 240 E 24th Ave, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: jeff robichaud
reviews.text: Tacky says it all but in a cool way. Food was excellent and atmosphere was fun and lively. Excellent outside play area for kids also. Our server/bartender was Michael (Navy Vet) and he had an outstanding personality and was a fantastic employee. Definitely deserved the 25% tip. We will definitely come again.

reviews.author: Karen Cordova
reviews.text: Good breakfast, even though the portions are quite small. Today we got shrimp & grit, TJ breakfast bowl. Highly recommend if you want something new. Not very busy during the morning.

reviews.author: C M
reviews.text: Every worker we came in contact with was friendly. Our waitress did a good job. Food was reasonably priced, delicious and came out in a timely manner.  Save room for the salted caramel cheesecake

reviews.author: Katherine
reviews.text: The best restaurant we ate at in gulf shores! We found parking really easily however we went around 4pm. Environment was super colorful and the place was decorated with duct tape. Immediately got seated and food came out quickly. Our waitress, Katie, was super nice and we joked around and got to meet “manager in charge of the day” Bryan! Staff was super sweet and nice. I got the steamed crab legs and it was super good as well as the butter, corn, and potatoes!!!!!! The rest of my party loved wha

reviews.author: JG
reviews.text: Nice waterfront breakfast.  I went here on Monday for breakfast. They weren't busy, got seated and drink order taken immediately.  Very friendly staff.  I ordered the Shrimp Omelette.  It was really good, the seasoning on the shrimp was excellent. I also got a Bloody Mary, which was good, but I really enjoyed the pickled green beans that were in it.  If you want to have a nice, relaxed, waterfront breakfast this is the place. Would highly recommend for locals or visitors.

name: The Gulf
address: 27500 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Shane
reviews.text: This place is my jam. On the water, great cocktails, great seafood. If we go to a place two nights in a row, you know we like it. Service was excellent both nights. Bobbie Jean and Yil took great care of us tonight and Panda the night before. If you're really hungry get something that comes with fries. We had the snapper BLT and the lobster and shrimp roll and that's a lot of food. The prior night was the poke bowl and mahi -mahi tacos...a little lighter.

reviews.author: Ellie Gunn
reviews.text: Really great lobster and shrimp roll. Even the fries are actually good - sometimes places skimp on the quality of their fries. Even on a chilly day having lunch by myself, I grabbed a hot toddy and enjoyed this view and had a great time. Tammy was really awesome. She always showed up at just the right time and was super kind. The folks behind the register and the bar were also incredibly kind and professional. Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Shari Kaauwai
reviews.text: I was curious about this place solely based on the reviews & photos describing The Gulf’s construction was made up of former shipping containers!! Coming from Hawaii 🌺, we receive our goods in shipping containers so of course, I was curious and had to visit. The food was unbelievably tasty & full of flavor especially the daily special (Shrimp & Grits, lots of shrimp with the right amount of spice sized in an amazing sauce), the Fried Grouper Sandwich (delicious and not greasy), & the fresh guaca

reviews.author: Joseph Raczynski
reviews.text: Clean, excellent service, and very good food. You order from a bar or walk up, and they deliver. The views of the channel and waterway is clear. It's informal but has a good vibe.

reviews.author: Chris Wilkinson
reviews.text: We had shrimp tacos and a shrimp bowl. Both were excellent.  Our food runner, Colin, was great. He checked on us several times, made sure we had what we needed and even took pictures for us.

name: LongHorn Steakhouse
address: 3810 Gulf Shores Pkwy, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Amy Timms
reviews.text: Our food was so so good. Steaks were cooked perfectly and the sides were on point.  The sweet tea was AMAZING!! Our waitress tho wasnt all that pleasant tho. Don't even remember her name but she wasnt from here i remember that. Everything else was GREAT. Oh, the host that day was absolutely wonderful!! He should've been Our waiter.

reviews.author: Miroslav Vrvic
reviews.text: LongHorn Steakhouse delivered a fantastic experience—perfectly cooked steaks bursting with flavor, crisp salads, and warm buttery bread. The staff were genuinely attentive, upbeat, and knowledgeable, striking that rare balance of friendly and professional. A consistently excellent dining choice.

reviews.author: Tazmanian
reviews.text: My mom and I stopped and ate lunch here for her birthday during our Mardi Gras vacation. Our server Erica was extremely sweet and attentive, and made the whole experience 10 times better. The food was amazing, with both steaks being cooked perfectly if not very close to it. We planned to return at the end of our trip to drop off a gift for our server as well as try a different item on the menu but got caught up meeting some family and didn’t have time. Overall another very good choice for when y

reviews.author: Lori Johnson
reviews.text: The onion appetizer was incredibly delicious. The shrimp, steak and Potatoes were extremely tasty. The Bisque was so creamy and lovely.  The service was excellent. The Restaurant was clean.

reviews.author: David Taylor
reviews.text: Melissa was amazing. Took our order and it came out to us in perfect time. Had time to eat our salad, then the dinner came out and it was perfect. She waited on us a couple months ago and actually remembered us. We'll be going back and getting her again. Thank you so much. The Taylor's.

name: Papa Rocco's
address: 101 W 6th Ave, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Jamie Powell
reviews.text: Papa Rocco's is always welcoming place to go. Food is always great no matter what I order. Crab legs, pizzas, lasagna, steak, wings and peel and eat shrimp. Definitely worth a visit!! Lunch specials are cheap also and can't beat the live music. We also love to watch football on the weekends here as there are plenty of TVs and games on.

reviews.author: Gina Carter
reviews.text:
What an awesome lunch! We sat on their new front patio and celebrated our 7 months of sobriety while enjoying a NA Bush and deluxe pizza! The potato skins were amazing.

Lastly, Dan was the BEST server ever. So attentive, the order was perfect and he never let our drinks go empty!

reviews.author: Jeff Greenwell
reviews.text: Got this while on vacation. Thought we would give a local spot a chance with all the decent reviews. Pizza was undercooked, almost no sauce or cheese. Very undersized for being a “14 inch” pizza. $55 for 3 pizzas and dominos would have been better. Also not a good experience with the person on the phone taking orders. Take your business elsewhere if you want decent pizza. Not sure of other menu items.

reviews.author: Lynnette Foulk
reviews.text: It was so loud the waitress could not hear our orders. The Dr Pepper tasted funny, never got a new one. The waitress said she knew it would take awhile to fix it and offered a different drink. The food… wow, it was quite the let down. Based on the reviews I was surprised by how bland it was. It took a solid 45 minutes to get our order. My son’s wings came out cold. Between the waitresses not acknowledging ANYONE nor the other staff it took longer to explain that the food was cold. For the 1.5 ho

reviews.author: Robin Settle
reviews.text:
This was a fun place! It is basically a sports bar that serves great food. I had the manicotti with Alfredo sauce and my husband had the All Meat pizza.  Both were excellent, as was our appetizer, the stuffed mushrooms.  Though they were technically stuffed, they were really more like 'filled' (think gooey pizza topping - really good!).

The atmosphere was relaxed, the service was wonderful, and they even had live entertainment that night.

As we were leaving, we saw the sign to 'Feed the Fish'

name: Oyster Bar Restaurant and Marina
address: 13700 River Rd, Pensacola, FL 32507, USA

reviews.author: Brian Elliott
reviews.text: Had an amazing experience here. Got there early, sat outside on the deck. Food was delicious, service was excellent, timely and kind, thank you Mama T. They oysters were perfect, the blackened grouper perfectly cooked and not overly seasoned, even the sides were excellent.  I am sure this place gets packed and crazy.

reviews.author: Lu Desteli
reviews.text: Celebrated a birthday here couple weeks ago. It was my first time there. Lovely view of the water and birds and bridge. The food was excellent. We got there early so definitely saw lots of people come in after us but we had a very good time at opening on a Sunday afternoon. There is an elevator to the eating area for those who need a little extra help.

reviews.author: Jerry Dunne Sr
reviews.text:
(2 year update). Still a great place. Found out they have a 25% Discount in February. All good and beverages. If you like bread pudding you will love theirs

Great service, wonderful food and atmosphere, did I say great service?  Try the seafood bisque.

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.text: Went with the family for an early dinner and it was great.   The portions were a good size and tasty.  The wife had the red snapper and the kiddo had shrimp Alfredo.  The service was good and the location was great.   I would definitely add it to the list of places to eat when we come back.

reviews.author: Kurt Farnsworth
reviews.text: Two nights ago, the four of us ALL had Fantastic meals. Our server, Ava, was Absolutely Wonderful. She is an Outstanding asset to this business!  She made the entire experience a pure pleasure!

name: Lillian’s Pizza
address: 14514 Perdido Key Dr, Pensacola, FL 32507, USA

reviews.author: Traci Pryhuber
reviews.text:
OMG! 6 years in the south and we'd all but given up on a pizza that would meet our Chicago standards. Sorry it took so long, Lillians! Not only was the thin crust amd pan pizza on point,  the homemade meatballs were juicy and so flavorful.  Don't get me started on the marinara 🤤
You're missing out if you haven't tried this place! We will be back and back and back!

reviews.author: H. Hays
reviews.text: Had very high expectations for this place after all the fan fair surrounding the place. Well the reality did not live up to the hype. Had planned on bringing a group here next week and thought we would try it out first. Arrived just after opening and was seated promptly. Ordered the house made meatballs as an appetizer. Found them very very spicy and very dense. They also had hard inedible chunks of meat on the outside. My wife ordered the club sandwich which came with mayo on the side. I've nev

reviews.author: Chris Martin
reviews.text: Food was alright. Prices were pretty steep for what we ordered. Staff was friendly and quick. I had the meatball sub and this is only my opinion, but the meatballs were way too big for the sandwich. I had to cut it up which would've been fine but the plate I was given was a basket with tissue paper on the bottom. So needless to say, before every bite I had to be sure there was no paper. The pizzas were good. Pepperoni and cheese. Wings were decent. Kids icees were 20 bucks just for a souvenir cu

reviews.author: Featherbear19
reviews.text: We picked up a pizza on our way back from the beach because we heard it was a great place. We ordered it online and it was easy to do, they let us know when it was ready. We love thin crust because we were born and raised in Chicago. So we thought the flavor was great, spices, sauce, amount of toppings was on point however we all thought that the crust was a bit too thin, for our liking. Would we get it again while in the area? Absolutely. Just needed a bit more to hold all of the goodness. Othe

reviews.author: Mitchell Younts
reviews.text: Came on a Sunday afternoon. Our waitress Andrea was very helpful and attentive. She let us know we would enjoy the meatballs appetizer and was right, then helped us find the right shirt for my son. Pizza was really good, not just average but really good. Drinks were reasonably priced. Overall good experience. We will be back.

name: Mudbugs Dive Bar
address: 624 Gulf Shores Pkwy, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Daniel Rodriguez
reviews.text:
Great bar, it has was warm vibe, mostly locals.
Went to watch a college basketball game, has a nice big screen for games. Drinks were good, bartender was friendly and attentive. Ordered the hot wings, they were great!

reviews.author: Texas Rain
reviews.text: Mudbugs… live music out front, karaoke and watch your games! We have been here many nights, but tonight after ordering my hot wings which are always delicious, we decided to try THE ROCKEFELLER DIP!!!! Holy smokes… I’ve never tasted anything quite like it. It was spicy and creamy and just a delight to eat! Try it. It’s one of those things that makes a place like this even more special. Sitting on the front porch as Leslie masterfully played a range of “cover” songs beloved by all. Caro serves th

reviews.author: Jennifer Vogelmeier
reviews.text: We only stopped in for a quick drink but the bears are cold The people are nice the service was great and I like the atmosphere and will definitely be back when we come back in town.

reviews.author: Marcus Boleng
reviews.text:
If you’re anywhere near town and don’t stop by Mudbugs, you’re seriously missing out. This place is the definition of a true hidden gem. The moment I walked in, I was greeted with a smile and served faster than I ever expected—the bartenders here are incredibly friendly, quick, and genuinely on top of their game. Even when things get busy, they never lose that personal touch.

Now let’s talk about the food—absolutely fantastic. Not just “good for a bar” good… I’m talking legitimately delicious.

reviews.author: Follow.TyMcConnell
reviews.text:
Mudbugs is the definition of a true local watering hole. The bartenders are always on point — friendly, fast, and they make you feel like family the second you walk in. The kitchen is just as impressive. Dana is a powerhouse back there, serving up food that tastes like good ol’ Southern soul made with love.

The management and owner deserve their flowers too. They keep this place running smooth, and the owner is constantly showing up for our community in ways that matter.

If you want great peop

name: Ginny Lane Bar and Grill
address: 4851 Wharf Pkwy E suite D100-D106, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Marilyn Washburn
reviews.text:
Decided to try a place we hadn't been to before and we're so glad we did! The food was absolutely delicious (pecan crusted chicken, baked oysters in truffle and garlic, calamari, grouper topped with lump crab, and fried crab claws)!!
I've actually had better claws but they were still good. 👍🏼
It was lovely dining outside on Portage Creek and inside offered live music with a cozy, elegant atmosphere.
Our service was fast and friendly...wonderful off-season experience! 🥰

reviews.author: Carol Lengerman
reviews.text:
GREAT HAPPY HOUR MENU from 11-6pm

Shrimp special today: $20 all you can eat and comes with Cole slaw, hush puppies, and fries. Oysters were $1/apiece.  They were small but had good flavor.

Justin was a great waiter and we tipped him accordingly, but the bar service was unbelievably slow considering the staff to patron ratio was at least 2:1.

Great view of the ICW and yachts on the wharf.

This was not our first time here, and we were surprised at how run down it seemed.  With so many dining o

reviews.author: Whitney Prince
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience! My husband and his dad went fishing this morning on the pier and caught a cooler full of Red Drum, but we had no way to clean and cook it. GL has a "hook and cook" service so we called ahead and spoke to Clint. He was super helpful and told us to bring them in and they would clean and cook them for us. From the moment we walked in the door, everyone was so friendly and kind. Clint scooped up our cooler and took the fish to the back to clean and prep them himself. W

reviews.author: Zoe Gehman
reviews.text: Great live music on Friday night! Very extensive menu with great options. Had a frozen watermelon margarita, gumbo (absolutely amazing) and jalapeño focaccia

reviews.author: Brian M
reviews.text: Food was ok.  Had the Bayou Grouper.  Not bad, but not great for the price.  Nice happy hour though.  We might go back during happy hour, but pick other items.

name: Brick & Spoon - Orange Beach
address: 24705 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: H. Hays
reviews.text: This place was pretty busy for 10:30 on a Wednesday and we found out why! We were seated immediately upon entering.  Drinks brought out within minutes and order taken. Food was expedited with speed and precision. My wife ordered the patty melt, which was so hot she burnt her lip. My tacos were loaded with blackened shrimp and a perfect amount of seasoning. The Fries were hot and more addictive than that fast food place with a big M in its name. Our waitress Carolyn B was fast and efficient all w

reviews.author: Wanietta Stuckey
reviews.text: We arrived at Brick & Spoon for breakfast at 9:45 and we're seated immediately. The menu is big with a good variety. They serve cirn or cheese grits with almost all of their breakfast choices. My husband ordered the Traditional Eggs Benedict and breakfast potatoes. He had hoped for it to be on a homemade biscuit but it was on an English muffin. He said it was really good. I ordered the Western Scrambler with fruit. I got the berry fruit rather than the melon fruit. Delish! I couldn't eat all of

reviews.author: Eunice Watters
reviews.text:
Absolutely Amazing Experience!

If you’re in Gulf Shores and looking for a place that delivers on every level, Brick & Spoon is it!

From the moment we walked in, the customer service was warm, welcoming, and genuinely friendly. The staff made us feel appreciated and taken care of the entire time. You can tell they truly enjoy what they do.

Now let’s talk about the food… WOW. Everything was perfectly cooked and incredibly well-seasoned. Every bite was flavorful, fresh, and beautifully presented

reviews.author: Marialexandraa Ochoa
reviews.text: The food was fantastic. The restaurant was great but what really impressed us was the server. We were on our way out of alabama and got here at opening hour.  About 4 other groups walked in and she absolutely killed it. Nikki needs a raise. We got outstanding service and the food and drinks were a bonus! Make this stop if you're ever in town!

reviews.author: Bobbi Masino
reviews.text: The Brick & Spoon was delicious.  My husband and I went in for a late breakfast and really enjoyed our selections. I had the Fried Steak Breakfast which came on top of a delicious biscuit with gravy. Over easy eggs and a delicious spicy honey drizzle. My husband got the Cajun Shrimp Benny which came with a side of potatoes. He really enjoyed the entree the potatoes were just potatoes. The star of the show was the breakfast fries. That came covered in gravy, diced tomatoes, a Sunnyside egg on top

name: The Jellyfish - Seafood Restaurant and Bar
address: 13700 Perdido Key Dr, Pensacola, FL 32507, USA

reviews.author: Ashley Endsley
reviews.text: We were recommended to come her by a local as we need to feed a variety of pallets and needs. This had plenty of gf options, a wonderful variety on the menu satisfying both the sea food/sushi lovers and the gluten free or land animal lovers. Trish was our server and she handled our group of 12 with ease keeping our drinks filled and food coming hot. We highly recommend this place. If you’re a sushi lover the perdido and rainbow roll were amazing and the jelly fish burger was impressive. Basicall

reviews.author: Blake Powell
reviews.text: This place has a great vibe. Their 25% off for military and responders on Thursdays was truly respectable. From walk in to leaving, I had great service. I ordered an appetizer, Crab wonton and a couple of sushi rolls, the Man of War and Alaskan. Tasty but a little on the smaller side compared to other sushi places I've eaten. The rest of the menu looks great, you won't be disappointed bringing your friends here! 🪼

reviews.author: Celeste RC
reviews.text: I came here for vacation today and I loved everything about it. The quantity and quality of the food was perfect! I also appreciated how the servers wore gloves when handing the food. The waitress we had was absolutely delightful. She was patient, gave recommendations, polite and just an absolute delight. The atmosphere was very welcoming and calm as well. I was already having a hard day today from another restaurant that I went to which didn’t provide the best service but coming to this place,

reviews.author: J&P PBandJ
reviews.text: We had a good meal and great service. The room was a little bit cold so I kept my jacket on. The side room with more dining tables seems a little stark, but it could be because it wasn't crowded that evening. In addition to the posted pictures we had Parmesan grilled oysters, which were excellent.

reviews.author: Amie J and Co
reviews.text: The food was amazing!  Don’t sleep on the Jellyfish burger…it is one of the best burgers I’ve ever had. Trisha was our server and she was wonderful!  Super sweet and attentive. She was great at describing the sauce for me.

name: Hurricane Grill & Wings-Orange Beach
address: 25755 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Amy White
reviews.text: Great place to eat! We had a hard time deciding on what to order. My husband got the smothered burgerito that he said was really good. I got the Mahi sandwich and it was good.  We are fans of a fountain Pepsi, so that was a plus for us as well.  Kristen was very sweet and took good care of us.

reviews.author: Rachael Gaylord Cargill
reviews.text: Husband and I were here for Christmas. Not many restaurants were open. The hotel gave us a list of options and we chose Hurricane Grill &Wings. We were seated quickly and our server Patti suggested the wings. They were so, so, good. I had one of the best margaritas in my life. And the Miami Vice drink was very tasty. We will be back. Great service!

reviews.author: The Wade Life
reviews.text:
So we went twice because it was so good!
Party of 14 mixture of adults and kids.
They were super accommodating.
They went the extra mile!
The food was incredible!
We got chips and queso as appetizer both times. The second time we got tortilla chips instead of kettle.
All the food was better than the high priced sit down restaurants.
The shrimp was the best we had in orange beach and Pensacola.
Steak tacos were amazing!
The fajita bowl was delicious!
The staff and the environment was incredible!

reviews.author: Mark Lewis
reviews.text: Always a wonderful experience at Hurricanes Grill and Wings! The food was absolutely delicious. It’s always so fresh, flavorful, and cooked perfectly. As always, everything came out hot and fast. Our waitress, LeeLee, truly made the visit even better. She was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed without asking.   Great food, great service, and a welcoming atmosphere. We’ll definitely be back and asking for LeeLee again!

reviews.author: Veronica M
reviews.text: By far, our favorite place we ate for 2025 Spring Break. Great food, great service, and a very cool vibe. Will eat here when we go back. Street corn was so good!! Burgers were fantastic.

name: The Keg Lounge and Grill
address: 26796 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Jeff
reviews.text: This was a nice hole in the wall bar.  Had lunch their and burgers were fantastic and all the food was cooked to order fresh.  People were very nice as well.  Of the beaten path but definitely recommend

reviews.author: ALD
reviews.text:
Walked into The Keg expecting burgers, beers, and the usual smoke cloud. Walked out full, happy, and mysteriously not stinky. Witchcraft? Science? Either way impressed!! 🍻 🍔
The nostalgia of this place is so cool!

reviews.author: Tommy LaConte
reviews.text: If you like a good burger then by all means visit The Keg in Orange Beach.  This little bar has an award winning burger that is sure to please.  I’ve been back several times and it never disappoints. The staff is always friendly and the beer is cold!!

reviews.author: christi Horne
reviews.text: I absolutely loved this bar! Great vintage place I feel I stepped back in the 80s and 90s.And Jack I think that was is name was a awesome dude me and my husband Sammy enjoyed talking to him about music 🎶.I highly recommend this place and absolutely the best Cheeseburger and onion rings I've ever had plus my husband was pleased too you could smoke in there.We will be back whenever we visit Orange Beach again.

reviews.author: Lori Hootman
reviews.text: We grabbed a drink at this super fun, casual bar.  Our bartender/server, Cindy, was so attentive and warm.   She greeted us, served us and greeted all who entered.  Great local bar with pool tables and gambling machines. The bar offers a neighborhood bar experience!

name: O'choppers
address: 25910 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: L Kelley
reviews.text: Came here for the first time after basically getting rained out at The Wharf Ampitheater. Food is great. Patty Melt and Chicken bites are a must. Have a couple of darker beer selections plus normal light beer options. Miro served us at the bar and when we moved to a table. Service was top notch. Energy and vibe is great. 🤟👍👍

reviews.author: Charles Ross
reviews.text: My wife and I visited O’Choppers twice and sat at the bar just for a couple of beers. It was extremely friendly, and the price for beer was extremely reasonable.  Definitely plan on frequenting them when we’re back in the area

reviews.author: Chelsea Ross
reviews.text:
I came in tonight, never been. My dad passed away this week and I just wanted to sit somewhere where no one knew me and have a drink. I was greeted by Lucas (sp?) and asked if he had a drink menu. He laughed and asked what I was in the mood for… he made me the perfect rum punch and had great
conversation. While he had no idea what I was going through, his smile and hospitality meant more than he knew. Beautiful bar atmosphere, great drinks and clean facility. Will be back again! Thank you.

reviews.author: Rocky C
reviews.text: By far the absolute best wings and onion rings around! The atmosphere is always fun, service is always excellent, and the price is just right. They definitely have a repeat customer with me.

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.text: I just stopped by for a drink yesterday, but this place is always a treat!

name: Cactus Cantina Canal Road
address: 25908 Canal Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Sweet_Southern_Living
reviews.text: Food is always delicious! The staff is friendly, brings your chips & salsa quickly 😋 and makes sure you don't run out if anything during your meal. Best Mexican Restaurant on the island!

reviews.author: Joshua Slavens
reviews.text: Another Mexican restaurant that gives you small portions for full price. Charging $40 for two of these is ridiculous! Dining in gives you bigger portions, but hard to support a business that rips you off with takeout.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.text: Food was REALLY good!!! Atmosphere isn't super traditional and this place gives fusion vibes. Food was great! Lots of flavor and variety, fast service, excellent margaritas! Such a great little laid back casual Mexican meal.  We will be back! Highly recommend the rainbow margaritas and 3 amigo dip ♥️

reviews.author: Kevin Johnson
reviews.text: So, I've heard Mexican food is non-existent in Gulf Coast Alabama.  This place consistently rated the best. Well, it isn't great. The food was ok, but not Mexican in the least. The chips were good, light and served warm. The sauce they came with was ok. The service was excellent and the atmosphere was good. I'm from Arizona,  so my standards are high. Will I go back, yes. It's all we have out here unless I cook my own.

reviews.author: Larry Crain
reviews.text: My go to restaurant whenever I'm in Orange Beach Alabama. Great food , amazing atmosphere, awesome wait staff & management, plus good prices! Chicken and steak quesadilla was huge, served fast & hot. If you haven't been to this restaurant on Canal Road you need to put it on your list to try.

name: Avenue Pub - Orange Beach
address: 4575 S Wilson Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Zoe Gehman
reviews.text: This is such a cool spot. You can beach up with your boat, hang out outside, get some drinks and some amazing food. The tuna dip with homemade pita chips was so good, would definitely get it again. All the food we had was very good.

reviews.author: Gary Leemgraven
reviews.text:
Fun Waterfront Restaurant. The Tuna Dip was delicious! And the Chicken Club was as well! Friendly Service making you feel welcome.
Well worth the visit

reviews.author: Karen Simmons
reviews.text: Just recently went here on a girls trip, our waitress Julia was a delight. The view and vibe are great. It’s very laid back. The smoked tuna dip with pita chips was delicious. The pub fries were lacking ( they were cold and the cheese wasn’t melted) my group had shrimp tacos ( really good) Parmesan Chicken ( good) blackened shrimp ( not good) fish n chips ( fish great, fries cold)  Live music (underwhelming)

reviews.author: William Wright
reviews.text: Stopped in today for a quick Bushwhacker! Really cool place on the Marina. Killer happy hour with beach vibes. Great place to take the kiddos and relax and enjoy some cocktails. The views here are amazing as well as the service.

reviews.author: Tony Strowger
reviews.text: Great place to pop over for a beer and some lovely pub food xx fish and chips really good and chicken wings tasty x shrimp was done before you could say boo. Very nice and thank you x

name: Shipp’s Dockside Grill
address: 27075 Marina Rd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Marlo Schofield
reviews.text: Our waiter was so fantastic! His service was amazing! So friendly and attentive. He said he was 22 but it seemed more like lucky 777’s 🍀! Five stars ! Thank you for a wonderful evening! Food was also delicious!

reviews.author: Pamela Pruett
reviews.text: Tajhe is an exceptional worker. I was impressed. Crab bisque was yummy. My filet mignon was butter melting in my mouth. Gravy was too salty and the French fried onion rings were not edible. Mashed potatoes we're good and didn't touch the green beans. The southern rum bread pudding was 1/2 a pan!!! Yum!!!!!

reviews.author: Eric Mealus
reviews.text: Wow, if the food taste matched the food looks this place would be fantastic.  Instead, we left a bit disappointed.  Of the three dishes we had at our table, the Grouper was the best of the three; both sides though were cold and the greens were on the sweet side.  The eggplant dish and the crab quesadilla dish were not worth every ordering again.  The eggplant was undercooked.  There was plenty of crab in the quesadilla and it was oddly tasteless.

reviews.author: jettt111
reviews.text: My gosh. We just ate here and got the Thursday filet mignon for old times sake. It was melt in your mouth tender , I got the tomato vinegarette dressing and it was the best ever. I added a lobster tail with melted butter and it was cooked perfectly. Our waitress was named “special “.  She was perfect with everything. It was a meal to remember.

reviews.author: Stephanie Thompson
reviews.text: This is our third year coming to the area and this was hands down the best meal we’ve had yet. The Creole and Rockefeller oysters were fantastic but the star of the show was the grouper pontchartrain. Best grouper we’ve ever had. The fried oyster salad was delicious as well. Our server Jocelyn was friendly and attentive. Wish we would have come here at the beginning of our vacation vs the end because we would definitely go back!

name: Pelican Grill - Orange Beach
address: 27267 Perdido Beach Blvd d105, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Youkai
reviews.text: Excellent food and cheaper than comparable places around it! We had the daily special Snapper with Creole sauce and it was excellent, a real standout were the brussel sprouts in oil and honey glaze. The Lobster Mac&Cheese Burger was very juicy and was a generous portion size as well so I even had leftovers. The specialty drinks were great as well, with special mention to the Tipsy Pelican being a great drink and dessert all in one. Highly recommend this place if you are in the area, I can't wait

reviews.author: Daneen England
reviews.text:
Very good blackened grouper with sweet potatoes and brussels sprouts. The grouper had some lump crab on it As well as some sauce. The flavors were very nice and blended very well together. reviews.author: Josh Walters

reviews.author: Stacy McNair
reviews.text: If you're looking for a great burger and in-house breaded chicken tenders, this is your place. Our food  was delicious and service was excellent! It was great to see DJ after many years! We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Ernie Root
reviews.text: Went for the all you can eat royal red shrimp and sausage, new potatoes and corn. They were constantly filling the items so they were hot, will definitely be going back it's on Saturday and Sunday.

reviews.author: Chooch
reviews.text: We just loved this experience! Went for the all you can eat Royal Reds! We had never had them and wanted to give them a try! So glad we did. The place was packed when we got there! We were lucky enough to get a table in the back yard! (It's the way to go!) The shrimp, red skins, sausage and corn on the cob was just delicious! It was like we were at a friend's house just hanging out in the back yard! Check these guys out! Get there early!

The live music was great, as well. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: James Wood

reviews.author: Chloe Stowe
reviews.text:

Staff members Jaime and Country were wonderful in their successful efforts to make sure we had an amazing experience and got home safely. Also shoutout to our great bartender McKenna, she was very attentive and sweet!

Cover charge of $20 per person for a fire hazard of a night club. Definitely no limit on people allowed inside. You cannot move around in it. Music was not good. Couldn’t even get to the bar to get a drink for twenty minutes.

reviews.author: Jamie Box
reviews.text: We went to see Kip Moore here. Awesome. We loved the layout. Only thing I'd say is they need one more set of bathrooms. The bar is shaped like a huge guitar. Atmosphere was cool I'd go back here no problem.

I could have dined and ditched and nobody would have known.. like nobody paid attention to anything. I had to find my own utensils and ketchup. I might go back because the atmosphere was nice but I hope them the best success. I won't let this first time experience stop me from visiting again and supporting local businesses!

reviews.author: Leigh Marsh
reviews.text:
We got the Nashville Hot Chicken fingers they were good but HOT. The service was great. Danielle made sure we could watch the Auburn game. I didn’t like the taste of the tap water so I got a different drink. The potatoes were so good !!
Ask for Danielle!!!

reviews.author: Brennan Howard
reviews.text: Great spot to watch football, grab some food, and have a few drinks. It is very pretty on the inside which is also a plus. We enjoyed the wings with the dry rub seasoning and the beer cheese & pretzel for an appetizer. Both were fantastic (with great ranch). The Tee Off burger was fantastic!! Very unique and one of the best burgers in the area in my opinion. Drinks can get expensive but we had a fantastic experience.

reviews.author: Meredith Wadkins
reviews.text: We love TEE OFF! The food is fantastic. We eat here on a weekly basis since it opened! Danielle was our server, she was excellent! Tried the new menu item - steak bowl - absolutely incredible 10/10.

reviews.author: Dustin Reeves

The service was excellent — attentive, friendly, and on top of everything without being overbearing. You can tell they take pride in both the food and the customer experience. Definitely a spot I’ll be coming back to and recommending to friends.

You put money on a pour smart card put it in the a lot where your beer is and pour! It charges as you pour!

reviews.author: Kyle Myers
reviews.text: I want to compliment James on being one of the best managers I have ever been served by. We came in town last week and he was an absolute pleasure to talk to. Showed us how the bar worked, let us sample a drink, and gave the best customer service I've seen in a long time. Being from St. Louis, it's hard to find genuine good customer service from people who care. Thank you for reminding us that good service is still alive in places. We had a great time here! and so will you.

reviews.author: J Taylor

I would do it again if we get back there some day. The dolphins were amazing!

reviews.author: Deb Wirtz
reviews.text: This was our 3rd trip with them, and they are simply the best! The crew is fantastic, and Captain Smitty (I hope I got his name right!) has been our captain every time. They are always wonderful and make the experience so much fun. We will absolutely be back!

reviews.author: Heather Youngbloom

reviews.author: Jesse Carbullido
reviews.text: I give it another 10 stars! I've lived here locally for 30+years and this is the best view and vibe to have coffee or eat lunch at hands down. I'm a huge foodie and it passed the test for me!

reviews.author: Matthew Bly

reviews.author: GARRET TAYLOR

name: Cafe Beignet of Alabama OB
address: 25405 Perdido Beach Blvd Suite 22, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: Rafe Bar
reviews.text: Beignets, beignets, and more beignets. Very delicious, super fresh. Great service, and delicious beignets what more do I need to say. I didn’t think about it at the time but not sure if they have a dipping sauce, but that would have been a good addition, but obviously not needed because I ate everything without even thinking about it. Bring cash, sometimes the card machine goes down.

reviews.author: Vanity Tucker
reviews.text: We absolutely love this place. We have eaten here for breakfast 3x this week. It’s quick, easy, and delicious. My son may have ate 6 in one hour. If you want an affordable quick breakfast to take back to the condo I highly recommend. The workers are also super friendly! Our go to when we are in Orange Beach!

reviews.author: Robbie Lynn Johnson
reviews.text: The beignets had a different taste to them - the owner told me she's had the business over 30 years and just uses beignet mix but it was like the buttermilk was stronger than usual - very good.  Little hole in the wall type of restaurant in the Rouses shopping center.  We enjoyed it.

reviews.author: Tom W
reviews.text: Fabulous beignets! Got the filled ones and they were hot and delicious. Front staff woman was very friendly as well. Definitely will be back.

reviews.author: STLA_1020
reviews.text: Very fresh beignets! They seem made when you order. Very puffy and delicious. Different than NOLA but good. French vanilla iced Coffee was also delicious. The atmosphere is the only thing that could use some upgrading. Older gentleman posted out front, smoking cigars, gawking at women makes it less desirable.

name: Cafe Beignets of Alabama GS
address: 200 W Fort Morgan Rd, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Andrea Van Someren
reviews.text: Yummy beignets, very old person vibe inside, keep to yourself, less joy, but hey the beignets were pretty good. Fresh or reheated a couple days later, so that’s a win!

reviews.author: Nick Norman
reviews.text: Cafe Beignets is a must stop every time we are in Gulf Shores! Best, Beignets in town! They even rival Beignets in New Orleans! They taste fresh every time, golden brown and just the right amount of powdered sugar. This is not some corporate giant company. This is a locally owned business. Please know that before coming. Sometimes they are cash only. I would rather support this small local business than a giant corporate chain any day.

reviews.author: Loving Living Green
reviews.text: JD and Denise could not have been any nicer! They were friendly first thing in the morning and that was so refreshing! They went out of the way to ensure that I had everything I needed for beignets to go! We will be back! -Campers and Campfires

reviews.author: lacey H
reviews.text:
My children and I were able to share fresh warm beignets both filled and original.
They were so warm, fluffy and delicious but the exceedingly joyful customer service is really what sets it off.
Thank you for making our trip so special!

reviews.author: Blair Bauer
reviews.text: I went in here with my grandfather yesterday morning and we had a good time! The beignets are very tasty and filling and the chocolate sauce is good as well. The staff was so kind and chatty. We love supporting local businesses. I wish they offered more dipping sauces and any kind of substantial food, because they really only offer coffee, beignets, and muffins which aren’t filling long term.

name: Gulf Shores Diner
address: 3639 Gulf Shores Pkwy #4, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Rosefaith Masterpiece
reviews.text:
The food was absolutely amazing. I went with the Philly Steak Omelet, and it did not disappoint. It was packed with flavor, perfectly cooked, and the portion size was filling.
Arwa made the experience standout. Her service was excellent. She was genuine, welcoming, and the kind of hospitality that makes you feel like a regular even on your first visit. Everyone is so kind and welcoming.
I would definitely come back.

reviews.author: Mary Steinacker-Grimm
reviews.text: This place is like coming home to family. In the year and a half that I have been eating at the Gulf Shores Diner on Sunday mornings with my parents, I literally feel like we are coming to the best place to have a meal on Sundays. All the staff treat us like family. The food is always delicious. The restaurant is always clean. You can buy local art. The menu is diverse and always made fresh.

reviews.author: Rob Huey
reviews.text:
No frills diner with good food, service and lots of options.

My brother-in-law (lives in this area) recommended this to me and I tried it this morning for breakfast. Andrew waited on me and he did an excellent job of making sure I had everything I needed. The food came out quickly and everything tasted great. It was a very good experience.

They also feature art from local artists which is very cool. I would definitely recommend stopping by here for breakfast.

name: Foam Coffee
address: 313 E 22nd Ave, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Jesse Tischauser
reviews.text: Super cute little coffee shop with a surf shop vibe tucked away behind what looks like a nice little wine shop.  Definitely worth checking this spot out.  The toast flight was delish!  We’ll be back again for sho!

reviews.author: Lindy R
reviews.text: Their cappuccino is delicious (didn’t get a pic 😢) and the s’mores latte is so yummy!! Surf break burrito was tasty too! I’ll be returning any time I’m at the beach!

reviews.author: Sandra B
reviews.text: Best coffee shop around!!!! Others got nothing on this place. Latte was as delicious as expected and better!! Also got a turmeric, black pepper drink with coconut milk…sounds strange but it also was a delicious non coffee beverage. Lots of choices. Atmosphere was extremely clean surf vibe. Very upscale but prices were very reasonable. Get a simple beverage or the most spruced up, either way it will not disappoint!!!

reviews.author: Michael Hicks

Only thing good was the pistachio matcha and plant life.

The fresh sliced to order meats and cheeses are great too.

reviews.author: Dan Snell
reviews.text:
We have eaten here numerous times over the past few years and the food has always been consistently delicious.  The coffee is fresh and the pastries are unique.
Yesterday we ordered the muffuletta and let me tell you, this ain’t your New Orleans style.  The sandwich was very large and absolutely fantastic!  The meats were similar, but the dressing and bread were deliciously different.

reviews.author: Natalya Koetsier
reviews.text:
